title: Number-Line Jump
instructions: Make a number line on the floor. Call a number or a simple sum. Jump to the answer.

title: Beanbag Answers
instructions: Ask a maths question. Throw a beanbag onto the matching number card.

title: Maths Obstacle Course
instructions: Set up simple obstacles. Solve a number challenge at each station before moving on.

title: Addition Bowling
instructions: Bowl over bottles. Count fallen and standing pins, then say the addition sentence.

title: Skip-Count Steps
instructions: Walk around the room counting in 2s, 5s or 10s.

title: Letter Hunt
instructions: Hide letter cards. Find them, say the sound, and think of a matching word.

title: Phonics Hopscotch
instructions: Hop on letter squares, say each sound, then blend them into a word.

title: Word Relay
instructions: Run to collect letters and build a given word.

title: Robot Blending
instructions: Stretch a word like a robot (c-a-t). Blend the sounds into the whole word.

title: Syllable Steps
instructions: Take one step for each syllable in a word.

title: Act Out a Story
instructions: Read a short story, then act out favourite scenes together.

title: Emotion Charades
instructions: Act out a feeling with no words, then talk about a time you felt that way.

title: Story Stations
instructions: Move between Beginning, Problem, Solution and Ending to tell a story.

title: Mystery Object
instructions: Guess a hidden object by asking yes/no questions or feeling inside a bag.

title: Puppet Interview
instructions: Interview a toy or puppet in character.

title: Compass Directions
instructions: Follow north, east, south and west instructions to find a treasure.

title: Map Treasure Hunt
instructions: Draw a simple map of the room or garden and follow it to an X.

title: Continent Corners
instructions: Run to the corner that matches an animal, food or landmark.

title: Weather Reporter
instructions: Look outside and give a weather report, including what to wear.

title: Land or Water
instructions: Jump to land or water when a place, animal or vehicle is called.

title: Sink or Float
instructions: Predict then test which household objects sink or float.

title: Magnet Hunt
instructions: Test objects with a magnet and sort magnetic from not magnetic.

title: Ramp Race
instructions: Race toys down a ramp. Change the slope or surface and compare.

title: Shadow Chase
instructions: Make shadows with a torch or sunshine and notice how they change.

title: Habitat Builder
instructions: Build a mini home for an animal and explain why it fits.

title: Puzzle Relay
instructions: Fetch jigsaw pieces one at a time and complete the picture.

title: Human Coding
instructions: Give step-by-step robot instructions to reach a target. Debug mistakes.

title: What Changed?
instructions: Look at a tray of objects, turn away, then spot what changed.

title: Build from Memory
instructions: Look at a block model, hide it, then rebuild it from memory.

title: Pattern Moves
instructions: Copy a movement pattern, then add the next moves.
